reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI theme plugin that applies TI6-inspired colors, chat-panel artwork, and an optional ribbon animation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供 TI6 风格的明暗主题配色、聊天面板翅膀与星空背景，并支持切换丝带动画。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web UI theme plugin offering TI6-inspired light and dark colors, chat-panel wings and starfield artwork, and an optional ribbon animation.

capabilities: Overrides web UI theme tokens for light and dark variants
Injects chat-panel background artwork and styling
Provides a user-toggleable ribbon animation layer
